tools.name: provision_user
tools.description: Create a new user account in PingOne AIC (ForgeRock Identity Cloud). Returns the new user's internal ID.

username.description: Unique username for the new account (e.g. alice.smith).

email.description: Email address for the new account (e.g. alice@example.com).

password.description: Initial password for the account. Must meet AIC complexity requirements.

tools.name: deprovision_user
tools.description: Permanently delete a user account from PingOne AIC by their email address.

email.description: Email address of the user to delete.

tools.name: update_user_status
tools.description: Enable or disable a user account in PingOne AIC.

email.description: Email address of the user to update.

enabled.description: Set to true to activate the account, false to deactivate it.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List or search user accounts in PingOne AIC. Returns id, username, email, name for each matching user.

filter.description: Optional OpenIDM query filter (e.g. 'mail sw "alice"'). Leave empty to list all users.
